email_subject: Application - Product Marketing Manager, AI Governance (EMEA)
email_body:
Hi Kong team,

I'm writing to apply for the Product Marketing Manager, AI Governance (EMEA) role. I build and market AI products myself — from an AI dog-care app on Google Play to a job-search assistant that scores postings and drafts tailored applications — so I know what it takes to translate technical capability into a story that lands with both engineers and buyers. At Episto I earned a #4 Google ranking for "PDKS" and built ~600 member profile pages on one consistent layout, and as a freelancer I ran a self-funded Google Ads test that delivered a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks for a kids' bike brand. I also built kxp.be single-handedly in English, Dutch and French, including GEO for AI search. I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so working across EMEA and travelling to your Brussels office is no problem. I'd love to talk about how I can help Kong own the AI governance conversation in EMEA.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Kong team,

I build and market AI products myself, which is why the Product Marketing Manager, AI Governance (EMEA) role at Kong caught my attention. Kong is building the connectivity layer for the AI era — securing, governing, and monetizing every LLM, MCP, agent, and API request in production — and I want to be the commercial engine behind that story in EMEA.

At Episto I earned a #4 Google ranking for "PDKS" and built ~600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association. As a freelancer I ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand that delivered a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks: I built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords, and presented the results to their team. I also built kxp.be single-handedly in English, Dutch and French, including GEO for AI search, and I sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services with a free site check as the first step in every sales conversation.

What draws me to Kong is the chance to own launches, content, and campaign execution across an entire AI portfolio, serving as the single interface between AI R&D and the demand generation, field marketing, and sales teams. I have done that translation work before: turning technical differentiation into buyer-relevant narratives, building landing pages and campaign assets, and reporting on what moves pipeline. My own products — PupSmart, an AI dog-care app on Google Play, and an AI job-search assistant that scores postings and drafts tailored applications — keep me hands-on with how real users find, try and stick with a product.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so working across EMEA and travelling to your Brussels office is no problem. In the first weeks I would map the AI portfolio's launch calendar and tiering framework, audit the current messaging and sales assets, and sit down with demand generation and field marketing to align on the next campaign brief. I would welcome the chance to talk through how I can help Kong own the AI governance conversation in EMEA.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
